subject: 75 minutes of weekly interval walking cut central fat in 315 adults
script: From Agewell Brief: 75 minutes of weekly interval walking cut central fat in 315 adults. A small dose of interval walking could offer big benefits for adults with excess waist fat, a new trial suggests. 315 adults with central obesity walked briskly in intervals for 75 minutes weekly. One weekly session reduced body fat and waist size similarly to three sessions. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
